# TRUFIT Customs

> Custom-fit mouthguards and dental protection products using 3D printing technology for athletes and dental health.

TRUFIT Customs specializes in personalized dental protection solutions including custom mouthguards for multiple sports, nightguards for bruxism, retainers, and whitening trays. All products leverage advanced 3D technology and at-home impression kits, with HSA/FSA eligibility for most offerings.

## Key Topics

- Custom-fit mouthguards
- 3D printing technology
- Sports protection
- Vaporbite performance technology
- Dental-grade protection
- HSA/FSA eligible
- At-home impressions
- Nightguard for bruxism
- Custom retainers
- Whitening trays
- Combat sports
- Contact sports
- Dual-layer impact protection
- BPA-free materials
- Professional athlete trusted

## Core Products

- [Custom Fit Sports Mouthguards](https://trufitcustoms.com/products/sports-mouthguard): Custom fit sports mouthguards with dual-layer impact protection and HSA/FSA eligibility.
- [Vaporbite™ Performance Mouthpiece](https://trufitcustoms.com/products/vaporbite): Vaporbite performance mouthpiece with jaw alignment and oxygen optimization features.
- [Nightguard](https://trufitcustoms.com/products/nightguard): Custom nightguard for teeth grinding and bruxism protection using 3D technology.
- [Custom Fit Retainers](https://trufitcustoms.com/products/retainer): Custom-fit retainers with at-home impressions, BPA-free, HSA/FSA eligible.
- [Professional Whitening Tray](https://trufitcustoms.com/products/whitening-tray): Professional-level custom-fit whitening trays with 3D technology at home.
